actions: Delay irreversible commitments until the deadline is verified.
Seek independent advice before you decide.
alternatives: A legitimate deadline set by a verifiable outside constraint.
An operational emergency that really does leave no time.
definition: Acceptance fixture: pressure to decide before there is time to verify the claim, the deadline or the alternatives independently.

examples.context: A caller who says they are from your bank.
examples.marker: An unverifiable deadline that forbids checking.
examples.response: Hang up and call the number on your card.
examples.utterance: You must confirm the transfer in the next five minutes or the account is frozen.

indicators: Is the deadline impossible to verify?
title: Time pressure (acceptance fixture)
validation: Verify where the deadline comes from.
Ask for reasonable extra time and watch the reaction.
